# Python script to extract the crown dS values individually for each tip, instead of using an average out approach. 

```{python, eval=FALSE}
from pathlib import Path
from ete3 import Tree
import pandas as pd

BASE_DIR = Path(".")
NEO_GENE_FILE = "neo_genes_values_with_outgroup_branches_with_segments.tsv"  # just needs the Gene column
ALL_OUTGROUPS = ["Fal_per", "Ans_ans", "Str_cam"]
ROOTING_PRIORITY = ["Str_cam"]


def reroot_tree(tree, priority_list):
    leaf_names = set(tree.get_leaf_names())
    for taxon in priority_list:
        if taxon in leaf_names:
            tree.set_outgroup(tree.search_nodes(name=taxon)[0])
            return taxon
    return None


rows = []
df_neo = pd.read_csv(NEO_GENE_FILE, sep="\t")

for gene in df_neo["Gene"]:
    tree_file = BASE_DIR / gene / f"{gene}_dS_tree.nwk"
    if not tree_file.exists():
        continue

    tree = Tree(str(tree_file))
    reroot_tree(tree, ROOTING_PRIORITY)
    all_tips = tree.get_leaf_names()
    outgroups_present = [t for t in ALL_OUTGROUPS if t in all_tips]
    ingroup_tips = [t for t in all_tips if t not in outgroups_present]

    if len(parrot_tips) < 2:
        continue
    crown_node = tree.get_common_ancestor(ingroup_tips)

    for tip in parrot_tips:
        rows.append({
            "Gene": gene,
            "Tip": tip,
            "Crown_dS_tip": crown_node.get_distance(tip),
        })

df_out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df_out.to_csv("neo_genes_crown_tip_distances.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

n_tips_per_gene = df_out.groupby("Gene").size()
print(f">>> Saved neo_genes_crown_tip_distances.tsv "
      f"({len(df_out)} tip observations across {df_out['Gene'].nunique()} genes)")
print(f">>> Tips per gene: min={n_tips_per_gene.min()}, "
      f"median={n_tips_per_gene.median():.0f}, max={n_tips_per_gene.max()}")

```
